methods.name: Longitudinal TMLE (ltmle algorithm): static, mixed static and dynamic regimes, contrasts, EIC standard errors
methods.reference: ltmle 1.x algorithm (Lendle et al. 2017) with ltmle's defaults (stratify = FALSE, gbounds = c(0.01, 1) on the cumulative g, SetA predictions, weighted-intercept fluctuation) and variance.method = 'ic', written out in R with glm and cross-checked in the case against ltmle::ltmle 1.3-0 (logistic-Q regime means and SEs to 1e-8); the linear Q model is p2a's Gaussian variant written out with lm
quantities: g and Q coefficients (two and three time points)
clever covariates and bounded cumulative g
ATE and dynamic-vs-never contrast: estimate, SE, z, p, 95% CI
randomized design with a known effect
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 600: coefficients, means, epsilons, H and cumulative g 1e-8 relative; SEs, z and CI bounds 1e-6; p-values 1e-6 relative / 1e-12 absolute; counts exact. p2a runs at tolerance = 1e-14, the case's glm.control(epsilon = 1e-14); the default tolerance 1e-8 is checked against the same tight values at Tol::iterative(1e-8)

methods.name: Longitudinal TMLE on a regime with few followers: ltmle's no-variation rule, score check and positivity warning
methods.reference: ltmle::ltmle 1.3-0 (glm, stratify = FALSE, gbounds = c(0.01, 1), variance.method = 'ic'), called once per regime and once for the two-regime ATE, seeded before each call; the written-out estimator of causal_ltmle does not solve the EIC equation on this design and is recorded for documentation only
quantities: counterfactual means (always, never) and their EIC standard errors
followers by node and subjects below the lower g bound at the last node
methods.tolerance: default tolerance (1e-8) against ltmle itself: the always mean, its SE, the ATE and its SE 1e-6 relative (ltmle fits at glm epsilon 1e-8; its slack measured on 30 regular data sets is 2.9e-9 on means and ATE); the never mean and SE (about 4e-11 and 5e-12, a clamped prediction's distance from 0) 1e-8 absolute; nodes, flags and counts exact
